recent_posts.title: A Guide to Camel Observability Services
recent_posts.summary: A practical guide to setting up observability for Apache Camel applications using distributed tracing. Covers two variants: Spring Boot (using Micrometer, Brave, and Zipkin reporter to send traces to Jaeger) and Camel Standalone (using camel-observability-services and the OpenTelemetry Java agent). Includes Maven dependency setup, RouteBuilder configuration, Jaeger deployment via Docker, and how to view traces in the Jaeger dashboard.

recent_posts.title: Parallel Testing With Gradle and JUnit 5
recent_posts.summary: A practical guide to running tests in parallel using Gradle and JUnit 5. Covers configuring maxParallelForks and forkEvery properties in build.gradle, demonstrates that Gradle parallelizes at the test class level (not method level), and addresses common pitfalls including shared resource conflicts (solved via org.gradle.test.worker ID) and static state issues with Singletons (solved via forkEvery=1 to isolate JVM per class). Includes timing-based examples to visualize parallel execution behavior.

recent_posts.title: JDBC Series
recent_posts.summary: A curated index of Baeldung articles covering JDBC from the ground up. Topics span loading drivers and URL formats, connection pooling best practices, executing statements (batch processing, auto-commit, PreparedStatements), working with ResultSets (streaming, pagination, JSON conversion), schema and metadata management, SQL logging with P6Spy, mocking JDBC for unit tests, and resolving common JDBC errors with MySQL and PostgreSQL.

recent_posts.title: Java Weekly, Issue 644
recent_posts.summary: Weekly roundup of Java ecosystem news covering JDK 26's new warning for final field mutation via reflection, upcoming JDK 27 early-access builds, and a broad set of releases including Spring AI 1.0.6/1.1.5/2.0.0-M5, Spring Shell 4.0.2, Testcontainers for Java 2.0.5, Micronaut, Apache Camel, and more. Also includes links on MCP integration with Java LLMs, Kotlin observability with OpenTelemetry, ArrayList vs LinkedList puzzles, vibe coding critique, and a pick on how good engineers write bad code at big companies.

recent_posts.title: IntelliJ Series
recent_posts.summary: A curated series of guides covering IntelliJ IDEA workflows for Java and JVM developers. Topics span IDE setup and configuration (environment variables, memory tuning, JVM arguments), project and build management (Maven conversion, Spring Boot config, external JARs), coding productivity (shortcuts, refactoring, auto-import, indexing), and debugging (Spring Boot, remote debugging, Docker, Java Streams).

recent_posts.title: Jakarta EE Series
recent_posts.summary: A curated series of links covering core Jakarta EE APIs organized by topic area. Sections include the Jakarta EE platform and core concepts (deployment, migration from Java EE, application servers), Servlets, JSP and JSF view technologies, web services with JAX-RS and JAX-WS, and Bean Validation. Each section links to dedicated Baeldung tutorials for practical, hands-on learning.

recent_posts.title: Java Maps Series
recent_posts.summary: A curated series of links covering Java Map operations from fundamentals to advanced patterns. Organized into sections: Map implementations (HashMap, TreeMap, LinkedHashMap, ConcurrentHashMap, EnumMap), creating and initializing maps, reading/updating/removing entries, iterating and streaming, and sorting/searching/comparing maps. Each section links to dedicated Baeldung tutorials on specific tasks.

recent_posts.title: Java List Series
recent_posts.summary: A curated series of Baeldung tutorials covering Java's List interface from fundamentals to practical operations. Topics are organized into five sections: List types and fundamentals (ArrayList vs LinkedList vs HashMap), creating and initializing lists (List.of, Arrays.asList, immutable lists), adding/removing/modifying elements, iterating and sorting, and searching and filtering. Each section links to dedicated in-depth articles.

recent_posts.title: Store Java Objects in HttpSession
recent_posts.summary: A beginner-friendly guide to managing Java objects in HttpSession. Covers how to store objects using setAttribute(), retrieve them with getAttribute(), and clean up session data using removeAttribute() and invalidate(). Includes practical code examples with a User class stored in a servlet, plus best practices like null checks and proper session invalidation on logout.

recent_posts.title: Algorithms in Java Series
recent_posts.summary: A curated index of algorithm tutorials implemented in Java, organized by category. Covers sorting and searching (binary search, quicksort, merge sort, heap sort), graph and tree algorithms (DFS, BFS, Dijkstra, A*), array and string techniques (two-pointer, Levenshtein distance), mathematical algorithms (Fibonacci, GCD, matrix multiplication), and optimization/AI algorithms (greedy, knapsack, minimax, Sudoku solver).
